pages.text: Right-click the typewriter with at least eight paper. With an empty hand, repeatedly click the keys to type. When a signed book is finished, right-click to collect it. Sneak-right-click to retrieve unused paper.
Pick a shell color when crafting or right-click with dye later.

pages.title: Named Typists
pages.text: Place a named mob in front of the keyboard to let it type with its own vocabulary. The machine uses eight paper for an eight-page signed book. A writing desk directly beneath the typewriter can receive the finished book.
